tools.name: glob
tools.description: List files matching a name pattern, sorted by path. Use it to find files by name or extension; use grep to search file contents and read to open a specific file. Patterns without a slash match the file name at any depth (*.ts), patterns with a slash match the path relative to the workspace (src/**/*.ts), and {} supports alternatives (*.{ts,tsx}). Hidden files are listed, files git ignores are not, and symlinks are skipped.

pattern.description: File name or path pattern to match. Omit it to list every visible file.

path.description: Directory to search, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Defaults to the workspace root.
